newsitem.title: JAMAICA: Jamaica says debt swap program helped environment.
newsitem.headline: Jamaica says debt swap program helped environment.

text.p: A bilateral debt reduction accord with the United States has provided some $4.1 million in funding for environmental projects, the Jamaican government said on Friday.
More than 200 projects have benefited from the program, started in 1991 as part of the Enterprise for the Americas debt reduction program.

Under the plan, a substantial portion of Jamaica's PL-480 and USAID debt was either forgiven or rescheduled. The rescheduled debt was paid, in local currency, to the Environmental Foundation of Jamaica, whose board consists of representatives from the U.S. and Jamaican governments, and local environmental groups.
The Jamaican government said the foundation is trying to set up a permanent trust fund.
